content.text:
Built **Closet Chaos**, a responsive 2D dress-up game featuring Riley, an adult cartoon character. Players can mix and match tops, bottoms, colors, and accessories, then trigger a goofy bounce animation to earn style points. It also includes a random outfit button, character naming, strength control, and optional sound.

Run it by opening `index.html` or serving the folder with a static web server. `node --check game.js` passed, and browser checks confirmed the mobile layout, outfit changes, and scoring work. Latest screenshot: `screenshots/closet-chaos.jpg`.

Changes are uncommitted.
